Successful authentication is required before making any other API calls, as the returned token is typically used to authorize subsequent requests.

request.description:
## Create Cash Sale Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Cash Sale Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`cash`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price for the transaction. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis value for the transaction. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes for the transaction. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`**. |

### Validation Rules

- `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**.
    
- `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`cash`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

## Delete Cash Sale Transaction

This endpoint is used to delete an existing **Cash Sale Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `DELETE`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/delete`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Cash Sell Transaction to be deleted. Retrieve this value from **{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **transType** | Integer | Yes | Transaction type identifier. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType`**. Use the transaction type corresponding to 1. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Cash Sell Transaction** ID.
    
- `transType` must always be **`1`** for Cash Sale
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| {{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType` | `transType` |

request.description:
## Create HTA Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Hedge-to-Arrive (HTA) Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price for the transaction. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be hta. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes for the transaction. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`**. |

### Validation Rules

- `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**.
    
- `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`hta`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

request.description:
## Update HTA Transaction This endpoint allows you to update an existing **Hedge-to-Arrive (HTA) Transaction**. ### Request - **Method:** `PATCH` - **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updatePost` ### Request Body | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the HTA Transaction to update. Retrieve this value from
**`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**
and
**`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetch`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. | | **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. | | **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. | | **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. | | **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. | | **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. | | **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. | | **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. | | **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`HTA`**. | | **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. | | **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. | | **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. | | **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. | | **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. | | **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price for the transaction. | | **isHTALock** | Integer | Yes | Basis Lock flag for the HTA transaction. Accepted values are **`0`** or **`1`** (`0` = Not Locked, `1` = Locked). | | **basis** | Decimal | Conditional | Basis amount. Required when **`isHTALock`** is **`1`**. | | **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. | | **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. | | **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. | | **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. | | **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. If omitted, an empty value is stored. | | **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListCodeByCg`**. | ### Validation Rules - `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. - `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. - `isHTALock` accepts only **`0`** or **`1`**. - `basis` is required when **`isHTALock`** is **`1`**. - `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`HTA`**. ### Lookup APIs Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs: | API Endpoint | Used For | | --- | --- | | `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetch` | `transactionId` | | {{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr | `transactionId` | | `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` | | `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` | | `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` | | `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` | | `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListCodeByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

## Delete HTA Transaction

This endpoint is used to delete an existing **Hedge-to-Arrive (HTA) Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `DELETE`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/delete`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the HTA Transaction to be deleted. Retrieve this value from `{{BASE_URL}}/`**transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **transType** | Integer | Yes | Transaction type identifier. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType`**. Use the transaction type corresponding to 2. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **HTA Transaction** ID.
    
- `transType` must always be 2 for HTA
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/`transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType` | `transType` |

request.description:
## Create Basis Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Basis Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`basis`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |

### Validation Rules

- `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**.  
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**.  
    
- `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`basis`**.  
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

## Update Basis Transaction

This endpoint allows you to update an existing **Basis Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `PATCH`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updatePost`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Basis Transaction to update. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetch`** and **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **isBasisLock** | Integer | Yes | Future Price Lock flag. Accepted values are **`0`** or **`1`** (`0` = Not Locked, `1` = Locked). |
| **price** | Decimal | Conditional | Future price. Required when **`isBasisLock`** is **`1`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg`**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`basis`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |

### Validation Rules

- `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**.
    
- `isBasisLock` accepts only **`0`** or **`1`**.
    
- `price` is required when **`isBasisLock`** is **`1`**.
    
- `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`basis`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetch` or `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

request.description:
## Create Custom Contract Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Custom Contract Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **contractName** | String | Yes | Name of the custom contract. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`customContract`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`**. |

### Validation Rules

- `cashGrainId` must be either **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**.
    
- `transactionTypeCode` must always be **`customContract`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `futureContract`, `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

## Delete Custom Contract Transaction

This endpoint is used to delete an existing **Custom Contract Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `DELETE`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/delete`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Custom Contract Transaction to be deleted. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **transType** | Integer | Yes | Transaction type identifier. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType`**. For **Custom Contract Transactions**, this value must always be **`13`**. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Custom Contract Transaction** ID.
    
- `transType` must always be **`13`** for **Custom Contract Transactions**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType` | `transType` |

## Create Firm Offer Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Firm Offer Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price of the transaction. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`firmOffer`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |

## Update Firm Offer Transaction

This endpoint allows you to update an existing **Firm Offer Transaction**.

### Request

- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updatePost`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Firm Offer Transaction to update. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetch`** or **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Accepted values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price of the transaction. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`firmOffer`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the transaction. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`**. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |

| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`**. |

### Validation Rules

## Delete Firm Offer Transaction

This endpoint is used to delete an existing **Firm Offer Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `DELETE`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/delete`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Firm Offer Transaction to be deleted. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. |
| **transType** | Integer | Yes | Transaction type identifier. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType`**. For **Firm Offer Transactions**, this value must always be **`14`**. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Firm Offer Transaction** ID.
    
- `transType` must always be **`14`** for **Firm Offer Transactions**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionType` | `transType` |

request.description:
## Update Percentage Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Percentage Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. |
| **percentage** | Integer | Yes | Percentage quantity for the transaction. Valid values are **1 to 100**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve available buyers from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain identifier. Valid values are **`MANUAL`** or **`1`**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`percentage`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year associated with the selected transaction. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Price for the transaction. |
| **basis** | Decimal | No | Basis value for the transaction. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. If omitted or left blank, the default value is **0**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference number or identifier. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes for the transaction. If omitted, an empty value is stored. |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | User Cash Grain ID. Required only when **`cashGrainId`** is not **`MANUAL`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListCodeByCg`**. |

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListCodeByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` is not `MANUAL`) |

## Create MBP Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Market-Based Pricing (MBP) Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cropInsurance/getCrops`**. Must be a valid Crop ID. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **futureContract** | String | Yes | Future contract name. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. |

request.description:
## Create Min/Max Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Min/Max Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM`**. Must be a valid Crop ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract month. Maximum **2 digits**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract year. Maximum **4 digits**. |
| **minPrice** | Decimal | Yes | Minimum price. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. Must be less than **maxPrice**. |
| **maxPrice** | Decimal | Yes | Maximum price. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. Must be greater than **minPrice**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be earlier than **deliveryEndDtm**. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than **deliveryDtm**. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve available buyers from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. Maximum **50 characters**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference details. Maximum **100 characters**. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. Must be a valid Entity ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **startDate** | String | Yes | Start date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be greater than or equal to **sellDtm** and earlier than **endDate**. |
| **endDate** | String | Yes | End date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than **startDate**. The minimum accumulation period must be **4 weeks** or **4 working days**, depending on the selected frequency. |
| **frequency** | String | Yes | Accumulation frequency. Accepted values: **`daily`** or **`weekly`**. |
| **accumulationDay** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`frequency`** is **`weekly`**. Accepted values: **1–5**, representing **Monday–Friday** respectively. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Negative values are allowed. Valid range: **\-999999.9999 to 999999.9999**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Source identifier. Accepted values: **`MANUAL`** or **`1`** (`1` represents **Gavilon**). |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListCodeByCg`**. Must be a valid User Cash Grain ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. Maximum **255 characters**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`minMax`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year. Must be a valid year. Maximum **4 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- `minPrice` must be less than `maxPrice`.
    
- `maxPrice` must be greater than `minPrice`.
    
- `deliveryDtm` must be earlier than `deliveryEndDtm`.
    
- `deliveryEndDtm` must be later than `deliveryDtm`.
    
- `startDate` must be greater than or equal to `sellDtm`.
    
- `startDate` must be earlier than `endDate`.
    
- `endDate` must be later than `startDate`.
    
- The minimum accumulation period must be **4 weeks** or **4 working days**, depending on the selected frequency.
    
- `accumulationDay` is required when `frequency` is `weekly`.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when `cashGrainId` is **`1`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

request.description:
## Update Min/Max Transaction

This endpoint allows you to update an existing **Min/Max Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `PATCH`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updatePost`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Min/Max Transaction to update. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM`**. Must be a valid Crop ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract month. Maximum **2 digits**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract year. Maximum **4 digits**. |
| **minPrice** | Decimal | Yes | Minimum price. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. Must be less than **maxPrice**. |
| **maxPrice** | Decimal | Yes | Maximum price. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. Must be greater than **minPrice**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be earlier than **deliveryEndDtm**. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than **deliveryDtm**. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve available buyers from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. Maximum **50 characters**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference details. Maximum **100 characters**. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. Must be a valid Entity ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **startDate** | String | Yes | Start date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. **This value cannot be modified after the transaction is created.** |
| **endDate** | String | Yes | End date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. **This value cannot be modified after the transaction is created.** |
| **frequency** | String | Yes | Accumulation frequency. Accepted values: **`daily`** or **`weekly`**. **This value cannot be modified after the transaction is created.** |
| **accumulationDay** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`frequency`** is **`weekly`**. Accepted values: **1–5**, representing **Monday–Friday** respectively. **This value cannot be modified after the transaction is created.** |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Negative values are allowed. Valid range: **\-999999.9999 to 999999.9999**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Source identifier. Accepted values: **`MANUAL`** or **`1`** (`1` represents **Gavilon**). |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg`**. Must be a valid User Cash Grain ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. Maximum **255 characters**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`minMax`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year. Must be a valid year. Maximum **4 digits**. |
| **isBasisLock** | Integer | Yes | Price Lock flag. Accepted values: **`0`** or **`1`**. A value of **`1`** enables Price Lock. |
| **isActualBasisLock** | Integer | Yes | Basis Lock flag. Accepted values: **`0`** or **`1`**. A value of **`1`** enables Basis Lock. |
| **price** | Decimal | Conditional | Average Price. Required when **`isBasisLock`** **\=** **`1`**. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **basis** | Decimal | Conditional | Basis value. Required when **`isActualBasisLock`** **\=** **`1`**. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Min/Max Transaction** ID.
    
- `minPrice` must be less than `maxPrice`.
    
- `maxPrice` must be greater than `minPrice`.
    
- `deliveryDtm` must be earlier than `deliveryEndDtm`.
    
- `deliveryEndDtm` must be later than `deliveryDtm`.
    
- `startDate` **cannot be modified** after the transaction is created.
    
- `endDate` **cannot be modified** after the transaction is created.
    
- `frequency` **cannot be modified** after the transaction is created.
    
- `accumulationDay` **cannot be modified** after the transaction is created.
    
- `price` is required when **`isBasisLock`** **\=** **`1`**.
    
- `basis` is required when **`isActualBasisLock`** **\=** **`1`**.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when **`cashGrainId`** **\=** **`1`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

request.description:
## Fetch Accumulation Details

This endpoint is used to retrieve **Accumulation Details** for a specific **Accumulator Transaction**. The response includes the accumulation schedule, accumulation dates, and accumulated prices.

### Request

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDetails`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **flag** | String | No | Specifies the type of data to retrieve. Accepted value: **`list`** (returns the accumulation schedule, including accumulation dates and prices). |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Accumulator Transaction. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Accumulator Transaction** ID.
    
- If `flag` is provided, the accepted value is **`list`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` (for existing Accumulator Transactions) |

request.description:
## Update Accumulation Price

This endpoint allows you to update the **Accumulation Price** for an accumulation record where the **Accumulation Quantity** is greater than **0**.

### Request

- **Method:** `PATCH`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updateAccumulationPrice`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **date** | String | Yes | Accumulation date to be updated. Retrieve this value from the **`accumulationList`** in the response of **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDtls?flag=list&transactionId={transactionId}`**. Format: **`YYYY-MM-DD`**. The date must match one of the available accumulation dates. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Updated accumulation price. Retrieve the existing accumulation record from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDtls?flag=list&transactionId={transactionId}`**. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. Maximum value: **99999999.9999**. |
| **id** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Accumulator Transaction. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- The transaction must be a valid **Accumulator Transaction**.
    
- The specified **date** must exist in the `accumulationList`.

request.description:
## Create Accumulator Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new **Accumulator Transaction**.

### Request

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/create`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cropId** | Integer | Yes | Crop ID. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM`**. Must be a valid Crop ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **quantity** | Decimal | Yes | Quantity for the transaction. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **contractMonth** | Integer | Yes | Contract month. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract month. Maximum **2 digits**. |
| **contractYear** | Integer | Yes | Contract year. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth`**. Must be a valid future contract year. Maximum **4 digits**. |
| **sellDtm** | String | Yes | Sell date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. |
| **deliveryDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be earlier than **deliveryEndDtm**. |
| **deliveryEndDtm** | String | Yes | Delivery end date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than **deliveryDtm**. |
| **accumulationLevel** | Decimal | Yes | Accumulation level. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. |
| **koType** | String | No | Knock-Out type. Accepted values: **`eu`** (European) or **`am`** (American). |
| **koLogic** | String | Conditional | Required when **`koType`** is provided. Accepted values: **`low`** or **`settlement`**. |
| **koLevel** | Decimal | Conditional | Required when **`koType`** is provided. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Must not exceed **accumulationLevel**. |
| **guaranteedLevel** | Decimal | No | Guaranteed level. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Must be less than or equal to **accumulationLevel**, greater than **koLevel**, and either blank or greater than **0**. |
| **duType** | String | No | Double-Up type. Accepted values: **`eu`** (European) or **`am`** (American). |
| **duLevel** | Decimal | No | Double-Up level. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Must be greater than or equal to **accumulationLevel**. |
| **buyer** | String | Yes | Buyer name. Retrieve available buyers from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer`**. Maximum **50 characters**. |
| **reference** | String | No | Reference details. Maximum **100 characters**. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`** using the selected `cropId`. Must be a valid Entity ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **startDate** | String | Yes | Start date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than or equal to **sellDtm** and earlier than **endDate**. |
| **endDate** | String | Yes | End date in **MM/DD/YYYY** format. Must be later than **startDate**. Minimum accumulation period must be **4 weeks** or **4 working days**, depending on the selected frequency. |
| **frequency** | String | Yes | Accumulation frequency. Accepted values: **`daily`** or **`weekly`**. |
| **accumulationDay** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`frequency`** is **`weekly`**. Accepted values: **1–5**, representing **Monday–Friday** respectively. |
| **truckingFees** | Decimal | No | Trucking fees. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **fee** | Decimal | No | Transaction fee. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Valid range: **0 to 999999.9999**. |
| **premium** | Decimal | No | Premium amount. Supports up to **6 digits and 4 decimal places**. Negative values are allowed. Valid range: **\-999999.9999 to 999999.9999**. |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Source identifier. Accepted values: **`MANUAL`** or **`1`** (`1` represents **Gavilon**). |
| **userCashGrainId** | Integer | Conditional | Required when **`cashGrainId`** is **`1`**. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg`**. Must be a valid User Cash Grain ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |
| **notes** | String | No | Additional notes. Maximum **255 characters**. |
| **transactionTypeCode** | String | Yes | Transaction type. Must always be **`accumulator`**. |
| **year** | Integer | Yes | Crop year. Must be a valid year. Maximum **4 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- `deliveryDtm` must be earlier than `deliveryEndDtm`.
    
- `deliveryEndDtm` must be later than `deliveryDtm`.
    
- `startDate` must be greater than or equal to `sellDtm`.
    
- `startDate` must be earlier than `endDate`.
    
- `endDate` must be later than `startDate`.
    
- The minimum accumulation period must be **4 weeks** or **4 working days**, depending on the selected frequency.
    
- `koLogic` and `koLevel` are required when `koType` is specified.
    
- `koLevel` must not exceed `accumulationLevel`.
    
- `guaranteedLevel` must be less than or equal to `accumulationLevel`, greater than `koLevel`, and either blank or greater than **0**.
    
- `duLevel` must be greater than or equal to `accumulationLevel`.
    
- `accumulationDay` is required when `frequency` is `weekly`.
    
- `userCashGrainId` is required when `cashGrainId` is `1`.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getCropsWithNativeUOM` | `cropId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/fieldCrop/getFutureContractMonth` | `contractMonth`, `contractYear` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/buyer` | `buyer` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerListByCg` | `userCashGrainId` (when `cashGrainId` = `1`) |

## Fetch Accumulation Details

This endpoint is used to retrieve **Accumulation Details** for a specific **Accumulator Transaction**. The response includes the accumulation schedule, accumulation dates, and accumulated prices.

### Request

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDetails`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **flag** | String | No | Specifies the type of data to retrieve. Accepted value: **`list`** (returns the accumulation schedule, including accumulation dates and prices). |
| **transactionId** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Accumulator Transaction. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- `transactionId` must be a valid **Accumulator Transaction** ID.
    
- If `flag` is provided, the accepted value is **`list`**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `transactionId` (for existing Accumulator Transactions) |

request.description:
## Update Accumulation Price

This endpoint allows you to update the **Accumulation Price** for an accumulation record where the **Accumulation Quantity** is greater than **0**.

### Request

- **Method:** `PATCH`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/updateAccumulationPrice`
    

### Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **date** | String | Yes | Accumulation date to be updated. Retrieve this value from the **`accumulationList`** in the response of **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDtls?flag=list&transactionId={transactionId}`**. Format: **`YYYY-MM-DD`**. The date must match one of the available accumulation dates. |
| **price** | Decimal | Yes | Updated accumulation price. Retrieve the existing accumulation record from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDtls?flag=list&transactionId={transactionId}`**. Supports up to **8 digits and 4 decimal places**. Maximum value: **99999999.9999**. |
| **id** | Integer | Yes | Transaction ID of the Accumulator Transaction. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr`**. Must be a valid Transaction ID. Maximum **11 digits**. |

### Validation Rules

- The transaction must be a valid **Accumulator Transaction**.
    
- The specified **date** must exist in the `accumulationList`.
    
- The accumulation record for the specified date must have an **Accumulation Quantity greater than 0**.
    
- `price` must be a valid decimal value with up to **8 digits before the decimal** and **4 digits after the decimal**.
    
- The maximum allowed value for `price` is **99999999.9999**.
    

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/fetchAccumulationDtls?flag=list&transactionId={transactionId}` | `date`, existing accumulation details, and current price |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/getTransactionListFromSolr` | `id` (Transaction ID for existing Accumulator Transactions) |

request.description:
## Get Customer Code List by Cash Grain

This endpoint retrieves the list of **Customer Cash Grain IDs** associated with the specified **Cash Grain Source** and **Entity**.

### Request

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/userCg/customerCodeListByCg`
    

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **cashGrainId** | String | Yes | Cash Grain Source identifier. Retrieve a valid value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/cg/cgSourceList`**. |
| **entityId** | Integer | Yes | Entity ID associated with the selected crop. Retrieve this value from **`{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId`**. |

### Response

Returns the list of **Customer Cash Grain IDs** mapped to the specified **Cash Grain Source** and **Entity**. Use the returned **`userCashGrainId`** value in transaction APIs that require it.

### Lookup APIs

Before calling this endpoint, retrieve the required values from the following APIs:

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/cg/cgSourceList` | `cashGrainId` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/transaction/entityByCropId` | `entityId` |

## getSettlementPrice

Retrieves the settlement price for a crop based on contrcat month and year provided.

---

## Authentication

This endpoint requires a Bearer token passed via the `Authorization` header.

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `{{TOKEN}}` |

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cropTypeId` | integer | **Mandatory** | A valid crop type ID from getCrops |
| `month` | integer | **Mandatory** _(normal contract month only)_ | A valid contract month number (e.g. `9` for September). Retrieve valid values from `transaction/getFutureContrcatMonths`. |
| `year` | integer | **Mandatory** _(normal contract month only)_ | A valid contract year (e.g. `2025`). Retrieve valid values from `transaction/getFutureContrcatMonths`. |
| `cropYear` | integer | Optional | The crop year . get from getActiveCropYear API |
